notes.zh: macOS 推荐 b12024：b11960 的 Metal 着色器在部分 macOS（如 15.6 arm64）上编译失败（constexpr 报错 → Metal 库初始化失败，lfm3 等新模型无法启动）；b12024 已在 macOS 15.6 arm64 实机验证（lfm3-1.7b 加载/推理正常）。Jetson 与 Linux x64 CUDA 仍为 b11960 自托管构建；linux/aarch64 暂留 b11609（官方 arm64 包 glibc 2.38 基座）。
notes.en: macOS recommends b12024: b11960's Metal shaders fail to compile on some macOS versions (constexpr error -> Metal init failure; newer models like lfm3 cannot start). b12024 verified on macOS 15.6 arm64 (lfm3-1.7b loads and serves). Jetson and Linux x64 CUDA stay on the b11960 self-hosted builds; linux/aarch64 holds at b11609 (glibc 2.38 base).
